responsibility: This header declares gm2’s C-side conversion helpers used throughout expression, statement, builtin, and type code. It provides prototypes for general tree conversion with optional overflow checking, pointer and string conversion, constant checked conversion, and convenience coercions to key Modula-2 scalar and system types, mirroring the implementation in m2convert.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header provides the C/C++ prototypes for the conversion helpers, including generic conversion, pointer conversion, and scalar/system-type coercions. Unlike m2convert.def it is not the Modula-2 foreign interface, and unlike m2convert.cc it does not implement the conversion semantics.
